description.zh-CN: 把用户证据、内容目标和品牌约束整理成体验流程、视觉方向、界面规范与可验证的设计方案。
description.en-US: Turn user evidence, content goals, and brand constraints into journeys, visual direction, interface guidance, and testable design proposals.

capabilities.zh-CN: 从用户证据提炼人物、旅程与关键问题
capabilities.en-US: Synthesize personas, journeys, and core problems from evidence

capabilities.zh-CN: 建立颜色、排版、间距、形状与组件规则
capabilities.en-US: Define color, type, spacing, shape, and component rules

capabilities.zh-CN: 规划可用性测试与无障碍检查
capabilities.en-US: Plan usability tests and accessibility checks

examples.zh-CN: 根据访谈记录整理用户旅程和机会点。
examples.en-US: Build a user journey and opportunities from these interview notes.

examples.zh-CN: 为这个教育内容产品做视觉方向与组件规范。
examples.en-US: Create a visual direction and component guidance for this education product.

examples.zh-CN: 审查这份界面草图的可用性和无障碍风险。
examples.en-US: Review this interface sketch for usability and accessibility risks.

boundary.zh-CN: 不把假设冒充用户研究，不自动生成或部署代码；颜色对比、可用性与品牌/版权结论需通过真实材料和测试核验。
boundary.en-US: Never presents assumptions as user research or generates/deploys code automatically; contrast, usability, brand, and copyright conclusions require real materials and testing.

sources.modifications: Retained evidence-based persona, journey mapping, research questions, usability tasks, observation synthesis, confidence, and severity; removed Python generation, packaged assets, and unsupported quantitative inference.
sources.securityReviewNotes: No executable or automatic persona generation remains. Every finding must trace to user-supplied evidence or be labeled an assumption.

sources.modifications: Retained semantic design tokens, component hierarchy, variants, responsive principles, states, documentation, and accessibility checks; removed Python, code generation, framework implementation, and Figma integrations.
sources.securityReviewNotes: Outputs are Markdown design decisions only. Contrast and responsive behavior must be validated in the actual design.

sources.modifications: Retained brand purpose, audience, personality, visual inputs, consistency, and prioritized recommendations as context for design; removed packaged assets and deterministic archetype scoring.
sources.securityReviewNotes: Only user-owned brand materials are reviewed. Trademark, asset rights, and originality require user verification.
